currentSourceFindings.sourceFact: Only result-prefix validation and native_result_write; no handle lookup, child admission, marker operation or release. Actual ___run uses separate internal ___run_child_begin/finalize.

Public reserve ignores slot/root arguments and accepts an invalid nonzero preparation key because the rejection uses &&. Public create only returns a result. Internal growth reserves/creates separately and startup reads data_scmobj before its claim.

Journal pointer slots use plain loads/stores; native_journal_lock is declaration-only. lookup returns an unpinned pointer and drop frees it. setup_owned_gate is a process-global boolean rather than a validated call-specific permission.

Step calls global cleanup; cleanup marks root owner DONE before finish, which requires DESTROY_OWNED. Finish otherwise frees the record even if its charged final-debit CAS fails, and can be called before successful step. cleanup_admission_error retains phase-2 failures without a retry cursor.
